title: GWM Benchmark V4.0 - Unseen Intervention Transfer
definition: A model-unseen retrospective action-transfer benchmark on New York City taxi-zone mobility. Models learn from the 2019 and 2022 policy transitions and forecast the first 12 action-aligned weeks after the 2025 Congestion Relief Zone toll begins.
single_new_question: Can an action-conditioned GWM transition learned from earlier real institutional changes forecast the spatial mobility trajectory after a new action, without using any post-action 2025 target as model input or training signal?

relationship_to_prior_versions.v2: Prospective temporal evaluation on existing land-state regions.
relationship_to_prior_versions.v3: Process-sealed geographic transfer on new land-state regions, including Runtime-R2 and Controlled-C2.
relationship_to_prior_versions.v4: Model-unseen real-action transfer in the urban mobility domain, extending the benchmark runtime from TWM to UWM.
relationship_to_prior_versions.naming_note: The earlier RegimeWorld NYC v4 research artifact is retained as prior falsification evidence. This suite is GWM Benchmark V4.0 and uses a separate machine-readable protocol.

rationale: All required official TLC, taxi-zone, action-boundary and MTA validation data already exist locally.
The 2019 and 2022 interventions provide two distinct admitted training transitions.
The 2025 intervention changes both action magnitude and spatial exposure, so it directly tests action-conditioned transfer.
The complete benchmark can run now and does not depend on future downloads or reservoir-operation records.

rejected_primary_candidate.reason: Its action vector fails the joint convex-support gate and the one-time sealed evaluation already contradicted transfer. It remains a published falsification artifact, not the V4 primary test.

architecture_decision.tradeoff: The 2025 outcomes have been inspected in prior research. V4 therefore claims a model-unseen retrospective action test, not an analyst-unseen blind test or a causal policy-effect estimate.

dataset.scene: New York City yellow-taxi demand and CBD flow around real fare and congestion-pricing changes

events.action: USD 2.50 yellow-taxi congestion surcharge for applicable Manhattan trips
Citywide metered-fare and surcharge component adjustment
USD 0.75 yellow-taxi per-trip Congestion Relief Zone charge with frozen CBD-zone exposure

weekly_aggregation.alignment: Each event starts a new seven-day block on its official effective date; pre-event blocks are counted backward from the previous day.
weekly_aggregation.aggregation: sum each target over seven admitted calendar days for each of 263 zones
weekly_aggregation.missing_zone_day_rule: materialize an explicit zero only after the daily panel admission rule has completed

official_sources.trip_records: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission monthly Yellow Taxi Parquet
official_sources.policy_exposure: MTA / New York State Open Data CBD taxi-zone polygons
policy_documents: New York State 2019 congestion-surcharge page, memo and court notice
MTA 2025 Congestion Relief Zone tolling and Taxi/FHV toll schedule

data_partition.development_selection: Two-fold leave-one-intervention-out validation using only the 2019 and 2022 events, followed by a frozen refit on both events.
data_partition.training_firewall: Every submission must include a hashed training-row manifest proving that no date on or after 2025-01-05 was used for fitting or selection.

action_contract.spatial_scope: 263-element frozen zone exposure vector derived from official CBD polygons
action_contract.construction_rule: Action features and spatial scope must be constructed from pre-event trips and official policy terms only.

relations.name: origin_destination_flow
relations.construction: top-8 outgoing OD relations per zone from training-safe observations

relations.name: action_exposure
relations.construction: zone self-relation carrying the frozen action exposure and numeric action vector

RUNTIME-R3.purpose: Extend the V3 model-neutral runtime contract from TWM land-state rollout to UWM action-conditioned urban rollout.
required_gates: twelve-step open-loop rollout with no observed 2025 state writeback
data, code, model, environment, seed and prediction hashes
same submission keys for every model

ACTION-A4.purpose: Test whether explicit action semantics and spatial exposure improve transfer to the unseen 2025 action.
required_negative_controls: CBD exposure rewire to 38 non-CBD zones

core_algorithm.name: action-modulated multi-relation Graph-GRU
core_algorithm.gwm_runtime_kernel_role: Own versioned state, action, graph, rollout, writeback, reproducibility and audit contracts.
core_algorithm.dam_gk_role: Encode geographic adjacency, OD transport and action exposure; aggregate relation-specific messages; modulate the recurrent transition with numeric action semantics; roll the state forward without observed target writeback.

primary_metric.name: macro_pre_event_normalized_mae
primary_metric.formula: For each zone and target, divide absolute forecast error by max(mean weekly target over the 52 pre-event weeks, 1); then average equally over 263 zones, four targets and weeks 1, 2, 4, 8 and 12.

secondary_metrics: metric by borough and CBD exposure
80 percent interval coverage when uncertainty is submitted

conditions: action-conditioned primary metric is lower than matched no-action DAM-GK
the paired 95 percent interval for action-conditioned minus no-action lies entirely below zero
the action-conditioned improvement direction holds for at least three of four targets
the action-conditioned improvement direction holds for at least four of five reported horizons
correct action semantics outperform both action-component permutation and CBD exposure rewire

release_stages.exit_gate: definition, local source inventory, metadata-only preflight and claim boundary pass
50,496-row action-aligned weekly bundle, graphs, action vectors and training-row manifest are materialized and hashed
five required models, six controls, Runtime-R3 replay and prediction commitment are complete
frozen evaluator publishes all scores, controls, failures and claim decision

completion_gates: All 72 required monthly TLC files are present and match admitted manifests.
All three event windows contain exactly 52 complete pre-event weeks and 12 complete post-event weeks for 263 zones.
No 2025 post-action row is present in any fitting, selection, normalization or graph-construction manifest.
Action inputs contain only numeric semantics and frozen spatial exposure; event IDs and policy names are prohibited.
All required models and negative controls emit the same 3,156 keys.
Runtime-R3 replay, artifact hashing and failure-state checks pass.
The evaluator passes constructed-answer conformance tests before formal scoring.
Every model and control result is published even when the action-conditioned model loses.
The final report repeats the non-causal and non-blind claim boundary.

supports_on_finalization: reproducible model-unseen action-transfer evidence for NYC taxi-zone mobility
matched evidence for whether explicit action semantics and spatial exposure add predictive value
benchmark-level Runtime-R3 execution and audit evidence
does_not_support: general validity across cities or action types
complete universal GWM Runtime Kernel product
general UWM, DAM-GK or GWM validity
